tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The markedly elevated NT-proBNP suggests possible heart failure or significant cardiac strain. HbA1c is mildly elevated, indicating impaired glucose control or prediabetes. Hematocrit is slightly low, but other red cell indices are normal, arguing against significant anemia. Lipid profile is within target ranges. Cardiac troponin is normal. No evidence of acute liver or kidney dysfunction. Overall, findings support chronic cardiac dysfunction and impaired glucose metabolism; clinical correlation and further cardiac evaluation are recommended.
